evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (gate: cargo lib+integration, bun, node, typecheck, gallery 158 passed); cargo test preparation:: --lib 37 passed; bun test tests/lib/preparation-service.test.ts 3 pass

notes:
Did: migration 20261025000420_phase3_preparation_runs.sql (preparation_runs: id, planned_meeting_id FK CASCADE, status running|completed|failed|cancelled|stale, provider_id, model_id, location_class local|lan|remote, sanitized_origin, prompt_version, briefing_id FK SET NULL (only when completed), failure_code, started_utc, finished_utc; partial UNIQUE index allows one 'running' row per planned meeting). preparation/runs.rs: in-memory registry (register/release/cancel per planned meeting) plus start (marks any leftover DB 'running' row cancelled INTERRUPTED, inserts the new run, one transaction), finish (only from running), latest. preparation/commands.rs: begin(pool, plannedMeetingId, expected, fresh, now) validates the route with trust::provider_route::validate_route_contract, maps the location class, checks the planned meeting, refuses a second run with PREP_ALREADY_RUNNING; execute(pool, appDataDir, run, budget, token, complete) builds the context from the saved selection, races briefing::compose against the token (cancel -> cancelled, nothing stored), rebuilds the context and compares (any difference -> stale, failure_code SELECTION_CHANGED), then saves; a briefing error -> failed with its code. Commands registered in lib.rs: prep_generate(plannedMeetingId, expectedRoute) -> PreparationRun (camelCase, includes locationClass) before dispatch, prep_cancel(plannedMeetingId) -> bool, prep_get_briefing(plannedMeetingId) -> {run: latest PreparationRun | null, briefing: {id, promptVersion, createdUtc, droppedCount, droppedQuestionCount, manifest, claims, questions} | null}. Event 'preparation-updated' {plannedMeetingId, runId, status} on start and finish. briefing::run is split into compose (model call, parse, verify) and save; run is now #[cfg(test)]. save re-reads the saved selection inside its write transaction and returns BriefingError::SelectionChanged (code SELECTION_CHANGED) when it differs from the manifest, closing the window between the stale re-check and the insert. selection::saved(executor, id) is the shared reader. Claim and Question derive Serialize (Question serializes as {claim, rationale}). preparation-service.ts adds generateBriefing, cancelBriefing, getBriefing, onPreparationUpdated(plannedMeetingId, handler) (filters by plannedMeetingId, returns the unlisten fn) and the types. 9 tests in preparation::commands (commands_tests.rs via #[path]), 3 bun tests.
Assumptions: prep_generate takes expectedRoute from the UI, like knowledge_start_extraction. Budget: budget_for(summary_context_tokens) = total (context - 2,000 reserved for the reply, clamped 1,000..12,000), per source total/2. The planned meeting id is passed to dispatch_completer as the outbound-ledger attribution id. prep_cancel cancels the token but leaves the registry entry until the task finishes, so a generate right after cancel can briefly get PREP_ALREADY_RUNNING. prep_get_briefing returns the latest stored briefing even when the latest run failed, went stale or was cancelled; the UI decides how to show that from run.status.
Learned: briefing and questions tests now save their selection first (save refuses a context whose selection is not the saved one). resolve_configured_dispatch and location_label are copies of private helpers in frozen knowledge/commands.rs. A panicking generation task would leave the registry entry (same weakness as knowledge). U-items wiring onPreparationUpdated must .catch the listen promise. Gallery passed first time (158).
